notes.title: NEW HANEDA GIRL UPDATE ㊥🤖
notes.content:
We would like to thank everyone for all the support received after the release of Haneda Girl, we continue working to make Haneda Girl the best experience possible.

We leave here the improvements that brings this new patch:

[list]
[*] Language selector the first time you start the game.
[*] Screen vibration selector from 0 to 10 (before it was on/off)
[*] Hide mouse when playing with controller
[*] Calibrate some Platinum scores
[*] Minor adjustment in Portuguese localization in rank screen
[*] Minor adjustments in Japanese localization in the introduction
[*] Fixed issues with playing on monitors over 60hz
[*] Bug resolution (visuals, controls, phases, etc.)
[/list]

notes.title: Haneda Girl is NOW AVAILABLE on Steam!
notes.content:
[h1]🌸 Haneda Girl is NOW AVAILABLE on Steam! ⚔️ [/h1]
Slice through the system in this explosive pixel-powered adventure!

The wait is over! Haneda Girl, the stylish and frenetic 2D action-platformer from Studio Koba—the minds behind the acclaimed Narita Boy—is now live on Steam!

Step into the shoes of Hane-chan, a tiny warrior with a light katana named "KenChan," and pair her up with M.O.T.H.E.R, a heavily armed tactical combat mech. Switch between them in real time to take down enemies, clear levels, and unleash creative destruction.

[previewyoutube=KdQdMxcSp_8;full][/previewyoutube]
[h2]Two heroines. One mission. Zero mercy[/h2]

Haneda Girl thrives on momentum and creativity. Every fight is a sandbox. Every encounter is yours to master.

⚔️ Prefer the swift precision of a light katana?
💥 Or the explosive chaos of heavy machine guns?

There’s no one way to play. Just your way.

[h2]✨ Key Features:[/h2]
[list]
[*] 🔄 Swap between two characters in real time for strategic flexibility.
[*] 🎮 Fast, intense, and stylish combat—easy to pick up, hard to master.
[*] 🎨 Cyber-kawaii art style: a fusion of sweetness and destruction.
[*] 🧠 Multiple ways to solve every combat scenario. Get creative!
[*] 🚀 Built for speedrunners and casual players alike.
[/list]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3169790/Haneda_Girl/

notes.title: Haneda Girl launches on May 23rd on Steam!
notes.content:
[h1]The waltz of destruction begins May 23th[/h1]

From the creators of [b][i]Narita Boy[/i][/b] comes [b][i]Haneda Girl[/i][/b], a brutal and stylish 2D action-platformer where speed, precision, and creativity collide.

[previewyoutube=K2FtEOKdPGA;full][/previewyoutube]
[h2]✨ A DANCE BETWEEN BLADE & BULLETS[/h2]

Switch on the fly between two contrasting warriors:
 🗡️ Hane-chan – Small, fast, and fierce. Armed with Ken-Chan, her razor-sharp light katana, she moves like lightning through enemy lines.
 💥 M.O.T.H.E.R – A massive tactical combat mech that speaks in bullet storms and brute strength.

Every fight is a canvas. Every approach is valid. Be sneaky, be strategic, or go full chaos mode. Haneda Girl rewards creativity and style in a high-octane battle system that’s easy to pick up and hard to master.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45193117/2733c310eb2798b84343651b60757514bfbfc551.png[/img]

[h2]🎮 FEATURES[/h2]
[list]
[*] ⚔️ Fast-paced, expressive combat – Swap characters mid-fight to chain attacks and adapt your playstyle.
[*] 💡 Multiple solutions for every encounter – Outsmart enemies with speed, strategy, or raw power.
[*] 🌸 Kawaii meets carnage – A unique visual style that fuses cute, clean pixel art with explosive action.
[*] 🕹️ For everyone – Built for hardcore speedrunners and casual players alike.
[*] 🔊 Original soundtrack – An immersive audio journey crafted to pulse with every step and slash.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45193117/162b987eeb2a6d75391ff61e41fe6de9021e7ad0.png[/img]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3169790/Haneda_Girl/

notes.title: Get your katana and combat robot ready for frantic and creative action!
notes.content:
[h1]Action, kawaii mayhem and stylish platforming[/h1]

Are you ready for a platforming frenzy like never before? Haneda Girl, the upcoming game from [url=https://x.com/studiokobaGAME]Studio Koba[/url], is about to drop, promising a fast-paced, creative, and stylish ride filled with destruction. If you thought platformers couldn’t surprise you anymore, think again—this game is here to challenge all your expectations!

[previewyoutube=bHtbQ05HBRI;full][/previewyoutube]
In Haneda Girl, you'll control two unique protagonists: Hane-chan, a tiny, agile warrior wielding her light katana, KenChan, to slice through enemies with precision; and M.O.T.H.E.R., a tactical combat robot armed with firepower and brute strength. Together, they must free the Data Empire from an invasion of threats—but how you approach each situation is entirely up to you. Will you rely on Hane-chan's speed and skill, or M.O.T.H.E.R.'s unstoppable force? The possibilities are endless!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45193117/3945a105bb61d463396f31e1510ae3ada2418304.gif[/img]

What makes Haneda Girl stand out is that it’s not just about action—it’s a playground for your creativity. Each level invites you to solve its challenges your way. Want to go in guns blazing and wipe everything out? Or do you prefer a more subtle strategy, finding the perfect angle to take down your foes? The choice is yours!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45193117/023ab89b245894e33cd7fd6f11f6f4a976476cad.gif[/img]

With its "kawaii" aesthetic and lightning-fast gameplay, Haneda Girl isn't just for hardcore players. Whether you're a casual gamer or a speedrunner, the game is designed for everyone to find their own rhythm in the chaos. And even better, each fight is an opportunity to get creative, as the character-switching mechanic lets you approach battles in different ways in real-time. Be bold, be unpredictable!

[b]Stay tuned for more news and get ready for the chaos ahead, add Haneda Girl to your Wishlist[/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3169790/Haneda_Girl/

notes.title: The Haneda Girl demo is now available ㊥🤖
notes.content:
[h1]The Haneda Girl demo is now available: Get ready for frenetic, creative action! ㊥🤖[/h1]

Haneda Girl, the highly anticipated action-platformer from the creators of Narita Boy, will be featured at Steam Next Fest. Studio Koba presents an exclusive demo for all players, now available for download. 

[previewyoutube=bHtbQ05HBRI;full][/previewyoutube]
Haneda Girl is a brutal and frenetic action-platformer. Overcome each level by switching between the two protagonists and unleash your creativity to achieve the best score. Dance the waltz of destruction and take down everything in your path.

Switch characters and clean up the threat in the quickest, smartest, and most efficient way. Each combat encounter can be resolved in many different ways. Be creative! From speedrunners to casual players, this game is made for EVERYONE!

The demo emphasizes speed, skill, and adaptability. As you navigate through action-packed and chaotic environments, you'll discover what it means to "dance the waltz of destruction." The brutality and quick pace of the combat are combined with a character-switching system that keeps the action fresh and exciting at all times.

Don't miss the chance to play the Haneda Girl demo at the Steam Next Fest!
